name: Pray
take: Prayer isn't reciting a wish list — it's keeping the line open with the One who runs everything. You don't pray to update God, you pray to stay connected. Talk to Him like He's in the room, because He is.
verse: Pray without ceasing.

name: Read the Word
take: You can't follow a voice you never listen to. The Bible isn't a textbook to finish — it's how God still talks. Even a few verses a day rewires how you see everything. Don't just read it, let it read you.
verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

name: Worship
take: Worship isn't the warm-up before the real thing — it IS the thing. It's where you stop staring at your problems long enough to remember how big He is. Sing even when you don't feel it; the feeling usually follows.
verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

name: Fellowship
take: You were never built to follow Jesus solo. Faith grows in a room with other believers — they catch you when you slip and call out what you can't see. Skipping church isn't independence, it's isolation. Show up.
verse: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another.

name: Serve
take: Jesus measured greatness by a towel, not a title. Serving someone who can't pay you back is where faith stops being talk. You don't grow by being served — you grow by getting low for somebody else.
verse: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

name: Give
take: Open hands grow a free heart; closed fists grow fear. Giving isn't losing money, it's loosening money's grip on you. You can't out-give God, so stop trying — just give glad, not guilty.
verse: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

name: Fast
take: Fasting is telling your stomach that your soul is hungrier. When you push the plate away to seek God, you find out He really is enough. It's not earning His attention — it's clearing the noise so you can hear Him.
verse: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

name: Rest (Sabbath)
take: Rest is a command, not a reward you earn by burning out. God built stopping into the week to remind you the world keeps spinning without you white-knuckling it. Trusting Him enough to rest IS faith.
verse: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

name: Confess & Repent
take: Hiding sin keeps you sick; bringing it into the light is where it loses its grip. Confession isn't God shaming you — it's the moment you stop carrying what He already paid to take. Come clean, find mercy.
verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

name: Memorize Scripture
take: You can't pull a sword you never packed. Hiding God's word in your heart means it's there at 2am when fear shows up, ready before you need it. Memorize it now so it can fight for you later.
verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

name: Witness
take: The best news you ever got wasn't meant to die with you. You don't need a degree to point someone to Jesus — just tell them what He did for you. A changed life is the loudest sermon there is.
motto: 📣 ONE BEGGAR TELLING ANOTHER WHERE THE BREAD IS
verse: Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

name: Give Thanks
take: Gratitude is just remembering on purpose. The fastest way out of a sour mood is counting what He's already done. Thank Him IN everything — not because it's all good, but because He's good in the middle of it.
verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

name: Obey
take: Love that won't obey isn't love yet, it's a feeling. Obedience is where you prove you actually trust His way over yours. The hard 'yes' to God now is the thing you'll thank Him for later.
verse: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

name: Forgive
take: Holding a grudge is drinking poison and waiting for the other person to hurt. Forgiveness isn't saying it didn't matter — it's handing the debt to God so it stops eating you. He forgave you the unpayable; pass it on.
verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another... even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

name: Get Baptized
take: Baptism is a public 'I'm with Him.' It doesn't save you — Jesus already did that — but it's the wedding ring on the new life. Going under and coming up says out loud: the old me's buried, the new me walks with Christ.
verse: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that... even so we also should walk in newness of life.

name: Take Communion
take: The table never lets you forget what it cost. Bread and cup, again and again, drag your eyes back to the cross when life tries to pull them anywhere else. Don't rush it — remember Him on purpose.
verse: This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

name: Be Still (Solitude)
take: God isn't usually in the noise — He's in the quiet you keep avoiding. Jesus, busier than you'll ever be, kept slipping away to be alone with the Father. Put the phone down. The stillness is where you actually hear Him.
verse: Be still, and know that I am God.

name: Encourage Others
take: A good word at the right time can hold somebody together who was about to fall apart. You probably have no idea how heavy the person next to you is carrying. Be the one who builds up, not the one who picks at.
verse: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

name: Endure Trials
take: The fire isn't proof God left — it's where faith gets forged. Don't waste the hard season asking only 'why'; ask 'who are You making me.' What's testing you now is building something that comfort never could.
verse: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

name: Examine Yourself
take: It's easy to audit everyone else and never look in the mirror. Every so often, let God search you — not to shame you, but to clear out what's quietly drifting. The honest heart-check keeps small cracks from becoming collapses.
verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts.

name: Walk Humbly
take: Pride is the one weight that makes you fall by lifting you up. Walking humble with God means you stop pretending you've got it handled and let Him lead. The low road in the kingdom is the only way up.
verse: What doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

name: Abide in Christ
take: A branch doesn't strain to make fruit — it just stays connected to the vine. Most burnout is from trying to live the Christian life cut off from the source. Stay close to Jesus and the fruit takes care of itself.
verse: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
